architecture_assessment.inline_eight_pending: Contradicted by live tail at host+0x908/+0x910 and sibling at host+0x918; eight 0x40 pending entries from +0x808 end at +0xa08.
architecture_assessment.replace_host_plus_zero_with_pointer: Contradicted by constructor and sibling paths: [host+0] is the outer owner backpointer.
architecture_assessment.move_whole_host_alone: Would break direct owner+0x159b0/+0x159c8 and adjacent sibling+0x162c8 sites; moving the sibling would propagate offset changes to other owner fields. The full write set is not known.
architecture_assessment.sidecar_candidate: Keeping the first four inline records and external extra storage would preserve current embedded addresses but requires new routing for every four-bound peer/flag/large/pending consumer plus owner registries and other subsystems. No complete hook set or working mod is established.

limits: Selected pins are a proven subset; computed addresses and callbacks can evade literal scans.
0x108b520 has direct-target plus RET/INT3 boundary evidence, not an unwind entry.
The 0x208aaa0 routine behaves as a byte-fill function in captured code, and callers pass zero and exact sizes; this map does not assume a C library symbol name.
No process was read and no game binary or report was modified in this pass.
